groups.name: Intent requirement in CLI argument parsing and validation
groups.rationale: Makes --intent a required flag on start, parsing it as a repeatable argument that accumulates values in order, then validates presence before any repository or git work.

groups.name: Intent storage and retrieval in rounds and sessions
groups.rationale: Records the stated intents on each round so later rounds can carry different intents without disturbing prior approvals, and retrieves current intents for display in session state.

groups.name: Documentation and help text
groups.rationale: Explains the intent requirement to agents, with examples showing repetition, and clarifies that intent should state what the branch is for, not list files.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
